purpose: Teach: 長期間/しまわ/すんなり/売り切れ/兆し/区切り/近日/工具

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、長期間、計画的に進めろ。
lines.en: Ren — research over the long term, advance it methodically.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Weight on each clause. Not rushing the instruction. The tone of someone who expects to be heard and understood. No condescension; this is how he talks to people he respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験ノート、しまわないと、紛失したら、大変ですね。
lines.en: Yes. The lab notebook — if I don't file it properly, we could lose everything.
lines.style: Alert focus. Slightly anxious undertone — he's thinking through the implications as he speaks. Careful, slightly clipped pacing. The worry of someone who thinks ahead to problems.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 査読、すんなり、通った論文、君の地力だ。
lines.en: The peer review came through cleanly. That's your own ability showing.
lines.style: Steady approval. Slight pause before the second sentence — genuine, not performative. Quiet firmness on 「地力」. This is him delivering praise the way he means it: clear, specific, unembellished.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。書店で、書籍が売り切れ、嬉しい誤算でした。
lines.en: Yes. The book sold out at the bookstore — that was a happy surprise.
lines.style: Quiet delight underneath. Not loud about it, but unmistakably pleased. A little wonder in the voice — he didn't expect this. Slight lift on the second clause, like he's still processing the luck.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手の研究、成長の兆し、感じるぞ。
lines.en: I can see the growth in your research. The younger generation is on an upward path.
lines.style: Observational, assured. Speaking from experience. A subtle warmth — he's noticing something he approves of. Even pace, no rush, the confidence of someone making a statement he believes in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の章ごとに、区切りをつけて、書き進めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm writing chapter by chapter and putting clear boundaries between each one.
lines.style: Methodical and focused. Slight emphasis on the structure — he's showing he has a system. Calm, deliberate pacing. The voice of someone solving the problem as he explains it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 近日、海外学会、発表のチャンス、与える。
lines.en: I'm going to give you a chance to present at an international conference soon.
lines.style: Direct announcement. Not asking permission; offering opportunity. Calm authority. A slight pause before 「発表」 — he's letting that sink in. This is something significant he's saying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験室の工具、整備、徹底しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've made sure the lab tools are in good maintenance — thoroughly organized.
lines.style: Quiet closure. Pride of completion sitting lightly under the words. Even tempo, finishing thought. The relief of someone tying off a detail before moving forward. Slight downward motion at the end — the period.
